_comment: Secrets are referenced from the environment by name (dollar-brace syntax, as in the token and api_key values below) and expanded at load; an unset var fails startup loudly. Prefer this over pasting literal keys. macOS launchd does not read ~/.bash_profile -- export the vars via `launchctl setenv` (osx-env-sync) or the plist EnvironmentVariables.

skills._comment: Directories of skillz-format <name>/SKILL.md skills (#74). Order is precedence: the first path defining a name wins, so a private catalog can shadow the public one. Omit the block for no skills.
